titulo: Esperar que + present perfect subjunctive (completed past action)
subtitulo: Espero que lo hayan pasado bien.
regla: To hope that something happened or has happened, use esperar que + present perfect subjunctive (haya + participle): Espero que hayas llegado bien. Never the preterite or the present perfect indicative after esperar que.

bloques.texto: **Esperar que** always takes the subjunctive. When you hope that something **already happened**, use the **present perfect subjunctive**:
English uses the past or present perfect (_I hope you arrived, I hope she has locked the door_), but in Spanish the indicative is impossible here.
Tip: **espero** pulls everything into the subjunctive, even the past.

lista.es: Espero que lo ==hayan pasado== increíble en Chile.
lista.en: I hope you all had an amazing time in Chile.

lista.es: Esperamos que lo ==hayas terminado== a tiempo.
lista.en: We hope you finished it on time.

lista.es: Esperan que los niños ==hayan llegado== temprano.
lista.en: They hope the kids got there early.

lista.es: Espero que ==hayan reservado== en el restaurante con tiempo.
lista.en: I hope you booked the restaurant ahead of time.

lista.es: Esperamos que ==hayan disfrutado== su estancia en nuestro hotel.
lista.en: We hope you enjoyed your stay at our hotel.

filas.t: Espero que hayas llegado bien anoche.
